newsitem.title: UK: NYMEX, IPE to announce oil futures pact -- paper.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX, IPE to announce oil futures pact -- paper.

text.p: The world's two largest oil futures markets are expected this week to announce a pact paving the way for lower dealing costs in key oil contracts, according to a report in the Financial Times.

The paper quoted Lynton Jones, chief executive of London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE), as saying there was scope for co-operation with traditional rival the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) in the trading of the two benchmark oil futures contracts, Brent Blend and West Texas Intermediate.
Lower trading costs could boost the overall volume of business in the two contracts, the paper said.
Jones also told the FT that the IPE aimed to diversify into a broad European energy exchange with contracts tailored to specific regional energy markets.
